{#dslw} # Introduction

{#tz0w} Esophageal squamous cell carcinoma (ESCC) is one of the leading causes of cancer-related mortality worldwide, with a high prevalence in Asia [@w:w1]. The outcome of patients with T4 esophageal cancer, defined as a tumor that invades neighboring structures (e.g., aorta, trachea, bronchus, and lung), is extremely poor [@w:w2]. Despite advances in surgical treatment, these tumors are usually considered inoperable; however, surgery alone has not improved the prognosis of patients with T4 esophageal tumors [@w:w3].

{#e4q6} Two distinct therapeutic options are currently available for T4 esophageal cancers: chemoradiotherapy followed by surgery (CRT-S), which comprises esophagectomy following downstaging of the tumor by CRT, and definitive chemoradiotherapy (D-CRT), which is designed to avoid esophagectomy by using maximum doses of irradiation [@w:w4]. Until now, D-CRT has been the standard alternative curative management for patients with locally advanced disease who are not eligible for or refuse surgery . To our knowledge, there is little information on the differences in the clinical outcomes of patients with T4 ESCC who undergo D-CRT and those who receive CRT-S. In this study, we discuss these two treatment modalities.

ops.markdown: The first failure sites were categorized as local, regional nodal, or distant. In previous series of patients with locally advanced esophageal cancer treated with chemoradiation followed by esophagectomy, the reported local, regional nodal, and distant failure rates were 4.5–67%, 10–57.9%, and 21–32%, respectively [@w:w15]. Local failure was associated with fewer lymph nodes (LNs) assessed and with close or positive margins, whereas regional nodal failure was associated with fewer LNs assessed and a larger pretreatment tumor size. Distant recurrence was associated with a higher pathologic nodal stage, ulceration, perineural invasion, residual disease, and a higher posttreatment PET SUV max, and patients who achieved a pathologic complete response were less likely to develop distant recurrence [@w:w16]. In the present study, all patients were judged to have been downstaged to an operable status on CT, endoscopy, and upper gastrointestinal contrast examination. In the CRT-S group, distant metastasis was the predominant pattern of failure (8/32, 25.0%), whereas local progression was uncommon (1/32, 3.1%). This low local progression rate may be partly explained by the high pathologic complete response (pCR) rate (37.5%, 12/32), the small number of involved lymph nodes (N0, 23/32; N1, 3/32; N2, 4/32; N3, 0/32), the high rate of negative margins (32/32, 100%), and the high R0 resection rate (30/32, 93.75%) [@w:w17]. In the D-CRT group, by contrast, local progression (27/74, 36.5%) was more frequent than distant metastasis (12/74, 16.2%); 6 of these patients also had an esophageal fistula and 2 had massive hemorrhage (Table 5). Taken together, our data suggest that CRT-S was associated with lower rates of local recurrence, esophageal fistula (*P* = 0.097), and massive hemorrhage (*P* = 0.348), although these differences did not reach statistical significance, a pattern that is in part consistent with previous studies [@w:w18].

**改动要点**

1. **文献部分句式理顺**：把 “the rates were 4.5–67% local, 10–57.9% regional nodal, and 21–32% distant failures” 改为 “…the reported local, regional nodal, and distant failure rates were 4.5–67%, 10–57.9%, and 21–32%, respectively”；数值范围与引用位置均未动。
2. **拆开三句平行短句**：原来 “Local failure was correlated with…Regional nodal failure was correlated with…Distant recurrence was correlated with…” 四句各自独立、重复感强；改为用 whereas 串起前两句，并把 pCR 那句并入 distant recurrence 一句，读起来更连贯。correlated 统一改为 associated with（回顾性研究更稳妥的措辞）。
3. **队列结果表述更准确**：原文 “Most cases in the CRT-S group had distant metastasis (8/32, 25.0%)”、“Most patients in the D-CRT group had local progression (27/74, 36.5%)” 中 “most” 与 25.0%、36.5% 并不相符，容易被审稿人挑错。改为“远处转移是 CRT-S 组主要的失败模式（8/32, 25.0%），局部进展少见（1/32, 3.1%）”；D-CRT 组改为“局部进展（27/74, 36.5%）多于远处转移（12/74, 16.2%）”。数字一个未改。
4. **合并重复信息**：原文 D-CRT 组先说 “distant metastasis rate was only 16.2%”，后面又说局部进展，信息分散；现合并为一句对比。
5. **结论句更严谨**：原句 “CRT-S reduced the local recurrence rate and the incidence of esophageal fistula (P = 0.097) and massive hemorrhage (p = 0.348)” 用 reduced 描述未达统计学显著的差异，是“过强主张”。改为 “CRT-S was associated with lower rates of… although these differences did not reach statistical significance”。这样反而更难被质疑，也与你后文“近似一致”的定性一致。另外把 “*p* = 0.348” 的小写 p 统一为斜体大写 *P*。
6. **细节润色**：“down staged to operable” → “downstaged to an operable status on CT, endoscopy, and upper gastrointestinal contrast examination”；“6 of whom were complicated with esophageal fistula” → “6 of these patients also had an esophageal fistula”；“partially consistent” → “in part consistent”。

四处置引用标记（对应原参考文献 [22–25]、[23]、[23]、[3,26]）的位置都已保留，参考文献编号不需要重排。
